rules: Carpet must read as carpet, not polished concrete.
No large directional pattern that competes with Isabel.
Floor brightness must preserve chair and heel silhouettes.

composition_rules: Guest chairs stay low enough that they do not obscure Isabel's desk area.
Chairs must not appear miniaturized relative to Isabel.
Keep a visible carpet band at the bottom of the arrival frame.
Do not place a foreground desk or table across the bottom edge.

acceptance_tests: Arrival view shows believable floor depth.
Isabel remains the dominant human focal point.
No chair intersects the camera near plane.
No foreground object blocks the open-center desk/leg view.
